name: 10107 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10107 (New York) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 10107 (New York) has 6 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.
